answer: One applicant leases a single coral raft above a reef for 120 days, posts 150 tokens and a 95 dollar fee. The raft holds 40 coral fragments, each tagged with a numbered disc, and an opal marker stone proves each weekly photo was taken on site. A neighboring diver signs the monthly tally and a surveyor checks the raft twice. A forged tally forfeits the deposit and bars the keeper 180 days. Faking 10,000 rafts freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 950,000 dollars, like building ten thousand rafts in a haven meant for one boat, and each extra raft still needs its own diver and disc.
